cutoff: Record actual execution timestamp/date per query; no search has been run by preparing this packet.
restrictions: Lawfully accessible files only; no bypassing paywalls, credentials or rate controls.
Acquire only the named missing exact reports, notices and their linked companions. Do not collect the portfolio again.
Preserve original and amended/replacement identities separately; do not remove quarantine or infer clinical benefit.
Record unavailable source as a gap; an abstract/URL is not delivered full text.
No unrequested drugs, no page generation, no public release.

gaps.verifiedGap: Both receipts currently resolve to the same medRxiv preprint bytes, visually confirmed on PDF page1. The journal-version file remains absent from this assigned packet.
questions: Does the delivered asset identify the exact journal DOI?
Which changes, supplement versions and outcomes differ from the retained preprint?
Which participants overlap the other ACTIV-6 reports? Do not count reports as independent studies.
exclusions: Do not redeliver the known preprint as the journal article.
Do not mix acute recovery and long-term symptom reports.

gaps.verifiedGap: The retained source appearances are quarantined and have no verified full-text assets. Notice/replacement linkage and the exact changed content remain uninspected.
questions: What does the notice change or withdraw?
Which exact replacement report/version and companions does the notice link?
Which findings remain affected, and what original/replacement differences can be located?
exclusions: Original retracted findings must not be restored as support.
Do not assume replacement identity from a title alone.

receiptContract.layout: one JSONL row per canonical report/question/required field; exactly Q01-Q15 field coverage per scholarly report
receiptContract.sourceIdentity: Every delivered file/version has a unique sourceId; companions may share canonicalReportId. Each field selects exactly one delivered sourceId and matching sourceHash. Repeated fields across companions HOLD.
receiptContract.missingness: Answered values are nonempty and source-located. Unresolved states require reason and nextAction; missing states have null values, while partial located values remain partial.
receiptContract.verificationBoundary: PASS_RECEIPT_ONLY verifies transfer structure and pinned provenance assertions; report identity, locators, numeric truth, scientific review and release remain unapproved.
receiptContract.downstreamSchemaAdaptation: candidate.schema.json and results.schema.json are shape references. The old candidate plan_id const was removed; newly acquired sources require a receiver-assigned prospective extraction plan and executable schema pinned after receipt.
